name: valorant-trn-stats
description: Personal-use Valorant stats scraped from tracker.gg. All data and credit belong to Tracker Network.
long_description:
Looks up Valorant stats on tracker.gg: profile, agents, maps, weapons, matches round by round, teammates, rank history and more.

For personal, private use only. Do not share, publish or sell this bundle. All data comes from Tracker Network (tracker.gg), which gets the credit for it.

Requests are slow on purpose: one at a time with a pause between them, and results are cached.

browser_executable.title: Chrome path
browser_executable.description: Full path to the Google Chrome program. Leave empty to use the Chrome that is installed.

headless.title: Hide the browser window
headless.description: Turn this off if Cloudflare starts blocking requests. A visible browser passes more easily.
